page: Microsoft Azure FX64-32mds_v2 is a high-memory, compute-oriented instance provisioned via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is driven by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, configured with 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs operating at clock speeds up to 4.2 GHz. The CPU subsystem features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 260 MB L3 cache pool. Supported instruction set extensions include AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and hardware cryptography accelerators (AES, VAES, SHA-NI). No dedicated GPUs are included.

A defining aspect of the FX64-32mds_v2 is its memory density, offering 1344.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 42.0 GB per vCPU. Storage capabilities include 3780 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, along with support for Azure Premium Storage. In benchmark testing, the large uncached memory bandwidth demonstrates top-quartile performance, achieving 241.54 GB/sec on read operations and 136.66 GB/sec on write operations. Compute metrics show top-tier single-core Geekbench results (2367.0) and strong multi-core PassMark CPU scores (52457.14), supplemented by strong compression throughput in gzip and bzip3.

The constrained core count relative to the massive memory array results in a specialized hardware profile. Workloads requiring heavy parallel core counts may experience bottlenecks compared to full-socket deployments, as reflected in average multi-core stress-ng tests and weaker large-model LLM generation speeds. However, for applications bound by single-core speed, cache capacity, and massive working memory footprints, the high memory-per-core ratio provides substantial qualitative efficiency by avoiding over-provisioning compute cores simply to acquire adequate memory capacity.

The instance is well suited for large in-memory databases, electronic design automation (EDA), caching tiers, heavy relational database servers requiring NVMe scratch storage, and data processing pipelines that benefit from high memory density and accelerated single-thread execution.
description: Microsoft Azure FX64-32mds_v2 is a compute- and memory-focused virtual machine powered by a 16-core, 32-vCPU Intel Xeon 8573C processor running up to 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides an exceptional memory-to-core configuration with 1344.0 GB of system RAM (42.0 GB per vCPU) and includes 3780 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark profiles show top-tier single-core performance alongside strong large-block memory read/write throughput and robust encryption handling. Operating without GPUs, the instance trades higher core density for extreme per-core memory allocation and strong single-thread performance. The instance architecture is best suited for memory-intensive enterprise databases, large-scale caching systems, financial modeling, and electronic design automation tasks requiring massive working sets without unnecessary vCPU licensing overhead.
